capabilities: Stop heading folds at the first top-level horizontal rule
End folds with %% fold-stop %% marker lines, optionally per heading level
Fold child headings together with their parent down to the boundary
Set a vault-wide folding default with folder rules and note property overrides
Restore normal Obsidian folding in the active note via a command
extras: Freemium: the vault toggle and end markers are free; folder rules, the override property and the effective-rule panel need Pro, and one payment unlocks Pro in all NoteMods plugins. Pro checks run through GitHub's device-flow sign-in and GraphQL API, storing the token via Obsidian's secret storage; the plugin sends no vault data and works offline up to 14 days after a successful check. The What's new tab suggests other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat and can be turned off. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or later. The README lists untested areas: nested callouts/quotes with rules, Linux/Windows runs, custom themes, the mobile app, real (non-mocked) GitHub sponsorship checks, and coexistence with other folding plugins.
problem: Obsidian folding hides everything under a heading until the next heading, so a divider cannot keep the following section visible when a heading is folded.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Heading-fold modifier that stops folds at horizontal rules so the section after a divider stays visible in Live Preview and Source mode.
